# Forma

> Forma is a game UI framework. UI is authored as .fhtml (HTML) and .fcss (CSS), converted to XAML at build time and validated by `forma-xaml`.

## Author UI
- [Dialect guide](html-css-dialect.md): how a view, stylesheet, token, binding and template are written.
- [Support matrix](html-css-support-matrix.md): every element, property, selector and at-rule, supported or rejected with the alternative.
- [Reference](html-css-reference.md): each construct with an example and the Forma type it becomes.
- [Cookbook](html-css-cookbook.md): tested recipes for menus, forms, lists, tabs and dialogs.
- [Agent design guide](agent-design-guide.md): design language, known engine limits and the change-verify loop.

## Tools
- [Agents and tooling](agents.md): the validate, format, preview, query and inspect loop; the skill, installer and MCP server.
- [Editor data](editor/html.customData.json) and [CSS data](editor/css.customData.json): completion and hover for editors.

## Optional
- [Everything in one file](llms-full.txt): the pages above concatenated for a single fetch.
